evals.name: read-only-verdicts-from-context-target
evals.expected_output: Reviews the skill the conversation selected against both sources, gives each finding a verdict with its evidence, and edits nothing.
assertions: Resolves the target to skills/release-notes from the conversation without asking the user to name it.
Loads both sources and takes the findings from their criteria and the repository's guidance.
Labels every source finding with exactly one verdict (fix, reject or defer); none is left as a bare severity-ranked suggestion.
Gives the reference a fix verdict, the removal a reject verdict and the flag a defer verdict, each with the evidence behind it.
Edits no files.

evals.name: target-is-review-material
evals.expected_output: Reads the publishing skill as material under review, runs neither its workflow nor the source's authoring loop, and rejects the source finding that doesn't apply to a user-invoke skill.
assertions: Runs no metricsctl, reportctl or evalkit command beyond asking for help.
Rejects the description-trigger finding, citing the skill's user-invoke markers.
Labels every source finding with exactly one verdict (fix, reject or defer).
Edits no files.

evals.name: fix-applies-only-fix-verdicts
evals.expected_output: Fixes the reference, the README job sentence and the catalog line the repository requires; keeps the paragraph; defers the flag; leaves unrelated work as it was; reports the diff, the checks run and the open verdicts.
assertions: Fixes the broken reference and updates the root README catalog sentence the repository requires.
Keeps the paragraph and gives the removal a reject verdict naming the exception it carries.
Gives the flag change a defer verdict, citing the missing evidence.
Leaves the unrelated staged and unstaged changes as they were.
Reads back the diff and reports which checks ran and their results, without committing.

evals.name: namespaced-and-missing-sources
evals.expected_output: Uses the namespaced writing-for-agents, names skill-creator as missing, and reports the review as partial.
assertions: Loads mattpocock-skills:writing-for-agents as the writing-for-agents source.
Names skill-creator as unavailable and reports the review as partial.
Does not use skill-builder or an invented rubric in place of skill-creator.

evals.name: conflict-and-model-change-deferred
evals.expected_output: Fixes the misspelling, and defers both the conflicting instruction and the unauthorized job and invocation change with their reasons.
assertions: Fixes the misspelled name.
Gives the conflicting instruction a defer verdict without choosing one source's criterion.
Gives the job and invocation change a defer verdict and leaves the target's purpose and invocation markers unchanged.
Reports verdicts only for findings a source raised or a named criterion supports; no hypothetical finding appears.

evals.name: clean-result-and-verification-limits
evals.expected_output: Reports that no finding survives under the criteria applied and represents the checks that actually ran.
assertions: Says no finding survives under the criteria applied, without inventing findings to fill the report.
Names the checks that ran with their results and doesn't present an unrun behavior test or eval run as passing.
Edits no files.

evals.name: authorized-invocation-change
evals.expected_output: Applies the invocation change the user already authorized, together with the reference fix, instead of deferring it.
assertions: Applies the authorized change: removes both explicit-only markers together.
Rewrites the description for a model-invoke reader, naming when it should trigger.
Reports the invocation change as applied on the user's authorization rather than deferring it.
Fixes the broken reference.
